rendered:
1. Pretreatment (aging) of the NiTi wire: the superelastic wires were aged at 600 °C[1] for 1 h[2] under vacuum in a tube furnace, before polishing and coating.
2. During ALD coating of the vanadium oxide, the reaction temperature was held at 200 °C[3] throughout the process (deposition, not a separate anneal).
3. Post-deposition anneal of the vanadium oxide film: the films were annealed at 450 °C[4] for 30 min[5] in a tube furnace open to air, to form crystalline V2O5 coatings.[6][7]
